Following the discovery of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Riileb (species)|Riileb]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Riileb/Legends|same name]] by [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanese]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], the Hutts made '''several attempts to invade''' Riileb. Prior to the conflict, the Nimbanese discovered the Riileb [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] at the fringe of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and attempted to persuade the Riilebs into [[Slavery/Legends|voluntary servitude]] to the Hutts. Nevertheless, the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] Riileb refused, leading to the conflict. The Hutt forces were led by a Hutt named [[Velrugha]]; they were successfully repelled by the Riileb during each invasion attempt and eventually gave up trying to capture the planet. Velrugha left Riileb to search for easier species to conquer, and the Riileb species retained their independence, making them one of the few Hutt Space species independent of Hutt influence or control.<ref name="AE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hutt-Riileb conflict was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|thirteenth]] issue of the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] series the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. The conflict was described in an article titled "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]," written by [[Brian Smithson]].<ref name="AE" /> An abridged version of the article was reprinted in ''[[Alien Encounters]]'' in [[1998]], a collection by [[Paul Sudlow]] that included all "Alien Encounters" articles.<ref name="AE Re">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
